name: Toil
source:
Welcome! You’ve died and found yourself in the afterlife. 

Don’t worry if eternal rest isn’t what you expected. There’s a war going on, after all, and we need all the help we can get. We need YOU! Yes, you! While the boys fight for the safety of your afterlife, the least you can do is work to keep them safe. 

Not sure if you’re cut out for it? War is everyone’s business, and these ships need fixing. You may as well get to work.

[From [url=https://borderbreakers.itch.io/toil]itch.io[/url]]
